questions.question: How should I produce the `od -c settings.ini | tail -n 6` bytes you asked for?

options.label: Give a hand-rendered byte dump instead
options.description: I render the exact od -c output for the [client] section by hand from the file (it's 4 short lines) and label it as manually rendered, not command output. No settings change.

options.label: You disable the sandbox, I rerun the real command
options.description: You set Settings -> Sandbox / sandbox.bash = "off" (or [sandbox] bash = "off" in config.toml), then I run the literal `od -c settings.ini | tail -n 6`. This runs shell commands unconfined in this container.

options.label: Skip the byte dump
options.description: Leave it at the confirmed file contents shown above.
